description: Phase-CONS — Web↔Telegram 1+1 consolidation + assistant-ui React webchat. 12 stories total, ~5 sessions. WAVE A backend (CONS-02..08, 7 stories): collapse duplicated InvocationBuilders + Hubs + executors; ship streaming/voice/ask_user/archive parity on web. WAVE B frontend (CONS-09..13, 5 stories): adopt assistant-ui (https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui) via useDataStreamRuntime, mount Thread/Composer/Message primitives on Aura dashboard. Backend SSE in CONS-07 is upgraded to speak Vercel AI SDK data-stream protocol so the assistant-ui runtime works out of the box. Plan source: .planning/post-drift-2026-05-21/Phase-CONS/plan.md + Wave B extension 2026-05-23. REFERENCE EVIDENCE: docs/research-2026-05-24-cons-tmp-survey.md surveys openhuman/assistant-ui/hermes/nanobot for concrete per-story patterns — read FIRST before each story (CONS-05 single Hub = openhuman channels/routes.rs broadcast, CONS-06 microcompact = openhuman context/microcompact.rs 0.8x threshold, CONS-07 SSE wire format = assistant-ui templates/minimal/app/api/chat/route.ts Vercel AI SDK frames, CONS-08 voice = openhuman ttsClient.ts + hermes per-chat voice_mode + ask_user is STUB-ONLY in openhuman so design from scratch with HashMap<question_id, ResponseChannel> + 5min SQLite TTL). Net LOC delta: ~-90 (Wave A dedup) + ~+800 (Wave B frontend) = +710. Per-module deep refactor on touch per CLAUDE.md.

userStories.title: Voice playback + attachments + voice dictation in assistant-ui
userStories.description: Three additive features. (a) Audio playback: when backend emits audio_url (CONS-08), assistant-ui Thread renders an audio player below the assistant message (HTML5 <audio> with controls). (b) Attachments: Composer accepts file drops/picks; uploads to /api/sources/upload (existing endpoint); on success, attachment appears as composer chip, sent with the message as a source_id reference. (c) Voice dictation: assistant-ui's built-in voice-dictation button uses browser SpeechRecognition API for STT input (no backend round-trip needed for input — Aura whisper sidecar is for voice memo storage, separate path).
